device.description: 12-bit 40 kSPS low-power sampling ADC with internal reference, byte-wide parallel and serial outputs
device.note: ads8506.pdf (SLAS484B) p.3 conversion time 15 us, p.4 electrical characteristics (data format, bus access/relinquish 83 ns, VDIG 4.75-5.25 V) and pinout, p.5 terminal functions, p.12 Table 2 control functions (parallel output), p.13 reading data, Table 3, Table 4 output codes, parallel output, p.14 Table 5 parallel conversion and data timing

commands.name: Convert (CS and R/C low)
commands.note: Table 2: CS falling with R/C low, or R/C falling with CS low, starts conversion N; new convert commands are ignored while BUSY is low

pages: p.3-4 (specifications), p.4-5 (pins), p.12-14 (control functions, output codes, parallel output, timing)
notModeled: analog inputs, input-range resistor network (R1IN/R2IN wiring: +/-10 V, 0-5 V, 0-4 V, Table 1), internal 2.5-V reference (REF output, REFD shuts it down), CAP buffer

codeFormat assumes the +/-10 V range (first in Table 1 / Table 4): SB/BTC high gives straight binary, which reads mid-scale (offset) at 0 V; low two's complement (0). On the unipolar 0-5 V / 0-4 V ranges the 0 V input is -full scale, which the model does not give
serial output (SDATA, DATACLK internal/external clock per EXT/INT, TAG daisy-chain input): SDATA and DATACLK are never driven; only the parallel port is modeled (DATACLK tied low, EXT/INT high)

the conversion starts when the CS/R/C low period ends (write access end) rather than at its falling edge; the 40 ns - 12 us convert pulse width and the rule that CS or R/C must be high before BUSY rises (else a conversion restarts without acquisition) are not checked
reading during a conversion returns the previous result (valid up to t11 after the start); the model keeps the same 0 V code throughout; the first conversion after power-up is invalid
PWRD (analog power-down; conversions inhibited, previous result still readable) is not read; VDIG must be <= VANA; acquisition time and throughput limits
BYTE high: the 4 LSBs on D7-D4 and D3-D0 ground (terminal functions, p.5)
variants: single-device datasheet; pin-compatible with ADS7806 and the 16-bit ADS7807/ADS8507. ADS8506I / IB grades differ in accuracy only.
